slices.focus: Colleen moves from damage control to a concrete rebuild: shortened core route, rearranged floor, and January volunteer training.
slices.summary: Colleen systematizes the post-failure rebuild. With Leonard's help, she rearranges a physical bottleneck on the apparatus floor. She splits the route into essential core stops and optional stops. She recruits two newer volunteers for a January training series focused on station-to-station handoffs, building a version that doesn't depend on the longtime storytelling style. Her framing: 'personality is a bonus, not the load-bearing wall.'
open_loops: Quiet test of core route with small group before January training
Station scripts, prop checks, and handoff sentences need final drafting
Debrief sheet after test run (timing, bottlenecks, confusing handoffs, one smooth thing)
